content:
Hi, we recently updated our Dataverse installation to version 6.11 and we were trying to configure the settings :SubmitForReviewDatasetDisclaimerText and :DatasetSubmitForReviewPopupCustomText but these settings don't support the configuration for multiple languages. I have tried to configure with the endpoint /api/admin/settings/$setting/lang/$lang but it didn't work. I searched in the release notes for 6.12 and 6.12.1 and I didn't find any mention about this problem.

I was trying to make some changes in the source code using this method and in my experiments I noticed that the method used to get a setting key with a language parameter was deprecated in version 6.9 and is marked for removal. Any plans on removing the option to configure multiple languages for a setting, or is there a different method that I am missing?
@César Ferreira hi! I went ahead and moved this to our new #internationalization channel since it's on topic!
I don't see anything about :DatasetSubmitForReviewPopupCustomText supporting multiple languages in #12373 but @Steven Winship would know for sure.
Since this is a setting in the database and not a bundle value it can only store a single value. Multi language is not supported.
I do see that settings have lang field but this was not implemented for this setting
That's what I figured. Thanks, @Steven Winship.
@César Ferreira if you want to go ahead and create an issue, please feel free.

Yes, I can create an issue. I was trying to implement a solution, but as I shared in the links above, the method to get a value for a setting using the language parameter is marked as deprecated and for removal.

Hmm, I see what you mean. Over at https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/commit/c4d2f4ad44307991eb813d0ad04aa6504c65cad8 @Oliver Bertuch marked that method as deprecated but I'm pretty sure the deprecation had to do with only using the enum rather than a string when calling into those methods. I don't think it was a deprecation having to do with using the "lang" column.
I have created an issue. I can also create a pull request with some changes I have made to support the configuration of multiple languages.
@César Ferreira thanks! A pull request would be great!
@César Ferreira thanks! I left you a comment: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pull/12903/changes#r4537976176
